heading: See the Full Phase 2 Layout Before Choosing a Sector
text: Locate Sectors O, P, Q, R, S and T on the wider Phase 2 plan, then use a dedicated sector plan for plot-level checks. Areas shown on a map are not a live stock list; we are not currently offering plots in Overseas, W or X.
